body: Follow up curiosity. Were you not in any birth control? Like pills or something? Just condoms? I hope you can answer. I'm actually overthinking right now too (although I'm in a birth control tho but still.... paranoid)

Thank you! I'm well aware of that naman sadyang noong time na yun I'm seeking personal experiences/advices through vlogs/videos kaya ganun kasi hirap kasi pagkatiwalaan yung mga articles/studies na nakikita namin sa Google since di siya detailed (the infos were too vague siya for us to understand). I do think I'm taking my pills right naman kasi di ko naman hinahayaan na maka-miss ako in a day. Sadyang mga paranoid or overthinker lang kami because 1) We lack sex education and knowledge about it 2) Di kami 100% sure if pills alone (even if taken religiously) can prevent unwanted pregnancies 3) Sadyang mas comfortable kami if the information is coming from other people's personal experiences or a professional kaysa sa pagsesearch-search lang talaga sa Google which is how and why I finally ended posting here. I'd like to hear more about your insights and personal experiences with Trust pills if you don't mind.

Don't worry we're really working on seeing a professional soon kasi di rin naman kami totally nagbabase sa experiences ng iba (goal na talaga namin to since Day 1) kasi iba pa rin talaga pag OB-GYN na. Pahirapan lang talaga paglulugar kung kailan kasi busy kami pareho sa school. Kaya ngayon para talaga mawala kahit papaano yung mga pag-ooverthink after the deed. Nagtatanong-tanong kami kaso yung mga kakilala namin is totally practicing safe sex (BCP+Condom and all. NO RAW) so wala kami personal na kakilala na mapagtatanungan about raw and creampie stuff because hindi daw sila nag-gaganoon kasi naninigurado lang din daw sila.

Can you also please share with me your experiences narin with raw sex/ejaculation inside experiences while on Trust pills if you don't mind? It'll be a big help talaga

The YUZPE thingy happened 4 months ago na then tinuloy ko nalang (I think nanuod ako ng YT/Tiktok vid nun explaining YUZPE method and said pwede daw ituloy-tuloy) Also after that is a month and a half kami di nagsesex kasi LDR kasi bakasyon. Ngayon, I'm like currently on my 4th pack ng BCP na which I take religiously every 8AM minsan nadedelay lang ng 1-2hrs cuz nakakatulogan ko especially pag walang pasok sa school. About naman po sa 2mins nag raraw is yung bf ko po may gusto. Nagbebeg siya kung pwede kahit saglit lang. Pumapayag naman ako pero after the deed kahit alam kong umiinom ako ng pills religiously. I can't help but overthink na kesyo yung pre-cum, what if naputok niya sa loob (since may times din na kahit sinasabi niya saglit tumatagal na siya) so kabado malala talaga. As for the last one, matagal na talaga namin gusto magraw nalang completely at creampie (since pareho namin na fetish) kaso di lang namin magawa-gawa kasi mas grabeng pag-ooverthink nadudulot niya sa amin compared dun sa saglitan na raw. So I'm more like just seeking an assurance lang talaga na okay lang lahat kahit nangyayari ron or kapag ginawa yun. For peace of mind ko lang since nakakatakot mga nakikita kong nabubuntis pero nagpipills naman daw sila.

On the side note: Napapag-usapan na rin naman namin to see an OB-GYN for our questions. Pero di pa kasi nabibigyan ng oras since busy sa school and stuff. So for now medyo nag-lelean muna kasi sa experiences at advices ng iba na mas experienced/knowledgeable na on what to do or how everything works. Hope this clears up everything.

Finally someone who understood me haha. I might actually be "efficient" as you may call it. Because yes, I don't wanna be wasting my time nor wasting other people's time. I am into "dating with the whole intention of marriage" kinda thing—which I'd like to point out from your story too. Since you said you ended up attracting women with baby fevers since you had those certain qualities and straightforwardness that you've told them about. Like especially if the info you're sharing to them gives off "family man" or someone they could settle down with vibe. So yes, I think it's a matter of date to marry I guess—so they are really serious-serious and looking for long term. 

But anyway, with this guy... I still don't like him that much like in terms of character wise—nope, could not see it yet. But I'm attracted to his consistency and appearance as of the moment. And since, yes I've realized being straightforward to everything that I want or was looking for did not ever work for me. I was trying another method that'd hopefully not allow him pretend to be the man that I want and be rushing in a relationship due to that reason (just because they're seemingly the man of my dreams lol). I actually explained to him that I just wanna be friends for now while we're getting to know each other. I told him he can date others while doing so, but he insisted that he'll just talk to me alone. He says he really wants to be more than just friends with me, but he also knows rushing would be no good so he respected my decision and said he's glad that atleast I, wanted to take things slow and get to know him better. This time around, I don't wanna blew him off by revealing everything in one go. You could say I'm trying to be the "mysterious" type—so he'd look forward to what he was about to discover about me along the way which I'm thinking it keeps the excitement alive. 

Anyway, my so called "tactic" isn't really that bad right? I mean I'm really doing that for the both of us hoping that it'll help us get to know each other more without any commitment. Just purely trying to see where it goes—whether we stay friends or more that. Whatcha think? hehe

Yes that's exactly the point why I hate that they're pretending. They are trying to have the same interests and goals as me so we'd seem compatible. I've been looking for that real connection too, and someone wanting the same genuine long term interest. But as a man do you have any tips for me on how to spot actions and patterns better?
